about_the_game:
A person treks across a vast world of mystery and nightmares. They've armed themselves only with what they could find in their home.

A first-person shooter full of strange horrors and uncomfortable sights, this game offers an experience of fast action and killing of various monsters that want to kill you. It features dark, atmospheric architecture, including that of castles, gothic structures, caves, tunnels, and more to come.

You must escape.

This game has low-poly, pixelated visuals accompanying atmospheric ambient sound design and a work-in-progress soundtrack.

Gameplay mechanics include:

- Fast-paced FPS action
- Short and simple puzzle-solving

- Secrets and exploration

- Different weapon types and ammunition

- Enemy types of varying degrees

- And more to come soon

Thank you for checking it out.

You may email me with any questions or inquiries.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains pixelated low-resolution depictions of blood and gore as well as psychologically horrific imagery and sound effects.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel/AMD CPU (i5-6600, Ryzen 3 1200)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Hexa-core Intel/AMD CPU (i5-8600, Ryzen 5 2600)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 4090 TI
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
